review_candidates.job_function: Project Management, Quality Assurance, and Training
review_candidates.description: Do you want to do work that really matters? Help us end avoidable blindness. Full-time role based in Da Nang, Viet Nam (flexible work-from-home arrangements available). Closing Date: Friday, 25 September 2026 ABOUT THE FRED HOLLOWS FOUNDATION The Fred Hollows Foundation is an international development organisation working to prevent blindness and restore sight. We continue to carry on the legacy of Professor Fred Hollows, who believed every person had the right to quality eye care, no matter where they live. The Foundation is known around the world as an organisation that works with purpose and determination. With a reputation for excellence, we are well known for making change happen. The Foundation has grown to work in more than 25+ countries throughout Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and the Pacific, as well as Australia. The Foundation has restored sight to more than 3 million people worldwide. We have an ambitious five-year strategic plan that aims to take us even closer to realising our vision of a world in which no person is needlessly blind, or vision impaired and Indigenous Australians exercise their right to sight and good health. To find out more about our work, please visit our website https://www.hollows.org THE OPPORTUNITY The Program Manager leads an assigned portfolio of projects and partner relationships, providing operational oversight, budget control and quality assurance. Reporting to the Country Manager, the role turns project concepts into compliant Project Design Documents, manages Senior Program Coordinators and Program Coordinators, and ensures projects meet quality standards, grant conditions and the objectives of the Viet Nam Country Strategy. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Oversee planning, implementation and quality assurance across assigned projects, aligned with annual work plans and donor agreements. Develop project implementation plans, concept briefs and procurement schedules with program colleagues and the MERL focal point. Maintain accurate project data and monitoring frameworks, apply field learning, and quality-check progress reports and evidence for new program development. Lead annual budgets and quarterly forecasts, monitor grant expenditure and variance reports, and ensure compliance with donor requirements and local laws. Build strong relationships with implementing partners, government departments and local health authorities, and support partner capacity and governance. Represent The Foundation at provincial and regional levels and advocate for eye health priorities. Line-manage, coach and develop assigned Senior Program Coordinators and Program Coordinators, building accountability, collaboration and engagement. WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED More than 10 years' NGO experience managing complex public health or development programs, ideally in eye health. Strong project management skills across partner engagement, implementation, monitoring and evaluation. Knowledge of Viet Nam's health, education and broader operating context, with a relevant bachelor's or master's degree. Fluency in English and Vietnamese, including strong report and proposal writing skills. Strong communication, relationship management, consultation and negotiation skills. Proven analytical, problem-solving, coaching and team-management skills. Cross-cultural experience and the ability to influence partners and stakeholders are highly desirable. Eligibility to work in Viet Nam and willingness to travel as required. How we recognise your contribution Through our internal programs and employee benefits we aim to create an environment where you will feel supported and empowered. Whether your focus is on continuous learning, professional development or finding an environment which enables you to thrive while balancing family or personal commitments, we have a range of programs in place to support you. To find out more about our benefits click here APPLICATIONS Please apply directly using the "Apply" button. Your application should include a CV and, preferably, a cover letter that outlines your interest in the role and addresses the key criteria listed in the “Key Responsibilities”, and “What you need to succeed” sections of the advertisement. Applications Close: Friday, 25 September 2026 The Fred Hollows Foundation is committed to protecting the rights of children and community partners in all areas where we work. Applicants are advised that The Foundation reserves the right to conduct police checks, and other screening procedures to ensure we maintain and promote a child safe environment, as well as to protect The Foundations reputation and values. In addition, The Foundation reserves the right to verify qualifications and credentials of applicants as part of our recruitment and screening processes. Please be advised: Fred Hollows Foundation will never ask for a fee during any stage of the recruitment process. All active roles are advertised directly on our website here. Please note we will not be accepting CVs via agencies for this role.

review_candidates.title: Portfolio Planning Lead
review_candidates.description: Bulk Infrastructure is seeking an experienced Portfolio Planning Manager to take a strategic and operational role in leading integrated planning across a portfolio of complex capital projects. You will strengthen our project portfolio by ensuring predictable, high-quality execution across multiple projects running in parallel. Bulk builds sustainable infrastructure that supports the digital society of tomorrow. As a leading Nordic provider of high-performance, energy-efficient data centre solutions, we design and operate infrastructure that powers the digital economy with 100% renewable energy. Located within the PMO, you will serve as a key link across the project lifecycle, from early phase to construction. You will own the integrated planning perspective across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring cross-project alignment, reliable forecasting, and consistent planning standards throughout the portfolio. You will drive integrated planning and planning governance across the entire project landscape, ensuring early-phase assumptions, development inputs, and execution plans are fully aligned. By equipping Project Managers with clear structure and delivering portfolio-level insights, risk assessments, and scenario analysis, you will strengthen decision-making throughout the project organisation. What you'll do As our Portfolio Planning Manager, your key responsibilities will be to: Lead integrated planning across multiple complex projects running in parallel while developing and maintaining integrated multi-discipline project schedules. Ensure schedules comply with PMO standards and planning best practices. Own the planning perspective across a portfolio of strategic projects, identifying cross-project dependencies, resource constraints, and delivery risks. Lead portfolio-level progress monitoring, schedule variance analysis, performance reporting, and milestone forecasting across multiple concurrent projects. Conduct schedule risk assessments and uncertainty analyses to strengthen forecasting accuracy and support scenario-based decision-making. Challenge planning assumptions and proactively identify risks, trends, and mitigation opportunities to improve delivery predictability and support better decision-making. Facilitate schedule reviews, planning workshops, and alignment sessions with key stakeholders. Drive improvements in planning tools, templates, and digital workflows, including exploring new technologies such as generative AI. Provide planning insights to support workforce and resource forecasting. Who you are You bring structure to complex situations and use analytical thinking to create reliable plans. You are comfortable working across multiple large-scale projects simultaneously and influencing senior stakeholders through structured planning, forecasting, and sound judgement. You identify risks early, ask the right questions, and approach challenges with a strategic problem-solving mindset. You communicate clearly, stay calm under pressure, and adapt quickly when plans change. You take initiative, seek better ways of working, and help raise planning quality across the organisation. What you bring 10 years of experience in multi-project planning for construction, engineering, or infrastructure projects. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or similar. Strong proficiency in Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar tools. Proven experience leading planning across multiple complex projects or project portfolios. Solid understanding of critical path, sequencing, risk, and schedule control. Experience providing planning insights, forecasting, and decision support to senior management or steering committees. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills. Fluency in English, written and spoken. It is beneficial if you also have Experience with data centres, energy, or mission-critical environments. Planning certifications (PMI-SP, AACE PSP). Experience with integrated project controls or earned value management. Experience coaching or developing other planners. Some travel to our sites will be required. Do not let a few unmet requirements hold you back from applying. If you have a unique background and believe you can make a valuable contribution to the team, we would love to hear from you. Why join us? A key role shaping how one of the Nordics' fastest-growing digital infrastructure companies plans and delivers a portfolio of strategic capital projects. Responsibility for planning across multiple major development and construction projects running in parallel, spanning early-phase development, new builds, and live campus expansions. A chance to shape a planning function that is being strengthened and elevated. A collaborative environment where your expertise is valued and your ideas are implemented. What we offer our Bulkies A dynamic, growth-oriented workplace with a strong sustainability focus. Comprehensive insurance (health, travel – business & private) and annual health check. Additional time off during Easter and Christmas. Monthly contribution to home internet costs and sustainable commuting. Annual wellness allowance to support an active lifestyle. Fully paid parental leave. Next step We review applicants continuously, so we highly encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The final application deadline is 15.09.2026. To apply, please upload your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this role. We conduct background checks on all hires. We may also require you to obtain security clearance and a police certificate of conduct. Bulk aims for gender balance and a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate against gender, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy and/or disability. We appreciate the time you have spent, and if the role aligns with your aspirations, we encourage you to apply! Racing to bring sustainable infrastructure to a global audience! We are a leading Nordic developer of digital infrastructure. Bulk develops data centers and fiber networks that serves as the backbone of our digital society. Bulk Infrastructure is a leading Nordic provider of sustainable digital infrastructure, specializing in data centers, fiber networks, and industrial real estate. Founded with a long-term vision, our founder remains a key owner , ensuring continuity and commitment to our mission. We are also backed by BGO , a global real estate investment management firm known for its expertise and leadership in the industry. Supported by a strong management team, solid ownership and delivered by a dedicated Team Bulk – we build something bigger than ourselves.

review_candidates.title: Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning Associate (8/9/26)
review_candidates.description: About Inkomoko Inkomoko supports entrepreneurs to grow their businesses in order to improve livelihoods, create jobs, and help communities thrive. In 2026, Inkomoko was listed by the Financial Times as the 5th fastest-growing company in Africa, supporting entrepreneurs across East and Central Africa to grow thriving businesses and build inclusive, resilient economies. Founded in 2012, Inkomoko has worked with more than 100,000 entrepreneurs, including thousands of refugee entrepreneurs. Inkomoko provides a combination of training, consulting, access to finance, and market-level systems change. We are the largest investor to refugee entrepreneurs in Africa. Inkomoko has 950+ staff in 50 offices across Chad, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, and South Sudan. Through Inkomoko's 2030 strategic plan, we are adding 3 additional countries to serve more than 550,000 entrepreneurs and growing our $30M loan fund to impact 7M lives. INKOMOKO VALUES All staff at Inkomoko are connected to a shared set of organizational values: Purpose: be solutions-oriented, produce high-quality work, be a global leader Achievement: push yourself to reach beyond what you previously thought possible. Improvement: be humble, engage in continuous growth through open & accurate feedback Bravery: willing to take risks, create a safe space for others, be compassionate, inclusive We Eat Goat: we celebrate success and support each other in hard times. Inkomoko is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer. Refugees, women, and persons who reflect the diverse communities we serve are strongly encouraged to apply. About The Role And Responsibilities The MEL Associate will be based in Kakuma, with frequent travel to different sites in the region. He/she will report to the MEL Manager Kenya, based in Nairobi. The roles and responsibilities for this position include: Data Collection (50%) Lead local data collection and data quality checks for Dadaab & Garissa, working with the program teams and the MEL teams for a coordinated approach. Work with the data team to provide feedback on the qualitative and quantitative data collection tools. Work with the manager to plan and execute data collections processes, including surveys and focus group discussions with a variety of client types Communicate with clients about data collection plans and processes, and organize all logistics for successful collection Update the project monitoring plan and monitor the indicators of different projects Test survey materials, and incorporate feedback in consultation with the MEL team Train and support field staff on the routine monitoring data collection tools, specifically Survey CTO Recruit, train, and supervise enumerators or internal stakeholders, ensuring they are trained and following all interview protocols for data collection Supervise the data collection in English, on the phone, or with digital tools/systems Lead focus group discussions, facilitating and taking notes to capture meaningful insights Ensure that surveys and M&E tasks are implemented in accordance with the M&E standard operating procedures set by Inkomoko Data Organization and Reporting (30%) Ensure high data quality and completeness by conducting data cleaning exercises Ensure proper storage of data and use of appropriate guidelines to ensure Inkomoko and client confidentiality Transcribe data from focus group discussions Analyze data in excel and other analysis tools and write summary reports Develop and share routine monitoring reports on monthly basis with program colleagues Assist in data analysis and donor/partner reporting Ensure data and privacy protections for all content Follow up and implement policies and protocols for all company and client data Other MEL Responsibilities (20%) Ensure client's perspective is incorporated in quarterly program review Support the communication team in gathering significant success stories Team meetings and general participation in a variety of company learning and collaboration activities Willingness and ability to travel 30% of your time to other field offices/ locations Perform any other activities related to MEL Requirements The MEL Associate should have experience in MEL, including managing complex data collection processes. Successful candidates will need to demonstrate: Bachelor's degree required 3 years of work experience in MEL or statistics fields Experience with Survey CTO, Stata, R, PowerBi is a plus, but excellent Excel skills are required. Experience managing teams of enumerators Technical skills and experience in data collection, tool development using mobile data collection software, and data management protocols Experience in quantitative and qualitative data methods Experience in statistical analysis software and/or qualitative data analysis software Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple deadlines—must be strategic and operational COMPETENCIES We are looking for someone who will; Manages Diverse Relationships - Relates well to a wide variety of personalities, values differences, and communicates effectively across diverse communication styles, cultures, and backgrounds Takes initiatives to Deliver - Thinks several months in advance, prioritizes objectives, implements reliably, and quickly identifies what will help or hinder goal accomplishment Fluent in Technology - Uses technology effectively to work efficiently and achieve desired outcomes Benefits This role is inside a high-growth, mission-driven social enterprise. By joining, you'll access: Meaningful work that directly contributes to sustainable livelihoods and job creation across East and Central Africa Competitive salary, and potential Performance-based bonus Incredible company culture, with opportunities for learning and growth Diverse colleagues across the region, and policies that demonstrate commitment to equity and inclusion A dynamic and entrepreneurial team environment committed to innovation and social impact Health insurance for self and family Staff savings and provident fund, negotiated bank rates for long-term employees Generous annual leave, parental leave, and sabbatical options. TO APPLY If you're excited about this role, please submit your CV, and tell us why you are the right fit for this opportunity. APPLICATION DEADLINE: Friday, 18th August 2026 Inkomoko is committed to justice, diversity, equity and inclusion. As we seek to reflect the communities we serve, refugees and women are strongly encouraged to apply . As a company we have policies that ensure fair treatment in the application process. NB: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Employment is conditional upon successful background checks and other verification as needed. All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and background screening checks. Inkomoko also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants' previous employers about any findings of sexual misconduct, fraud, or abuse. By applying, the job applicant confirms his/her understanding of these recruitment procedures.

The company supports clients, projects, and employers across the GCC and MENA regions, delivering tailored talent solutions that align with diverse business objectives. Second Step is recognized for its strong track record in placing employees at multiple levels across sectors such as information technology, e-commerce, telecommunications, and retail. Role Description We are looking for a Structural Engineer to join our Cairo team and contribute to the design and delivery of reinforced concrete (RC) and steel structures across various projects. review_candidates.title: Ingénieur d’Etudes en Tracé Ferroviaire
review_candidates.description: Vous souhaitez contribuer à la conception de grandes infrastructures linéaires de transport, au service de projets interurbains durables, équilibrés et responsables. Vous voulez participer à des projets structurants qui connectent les territoires, soutiennent leur développement et améliorent la mobilité des populations. Rejoignez les équipes d’Egis en Afrique, reconnues pour leur expertise des infrastructures ferroviaires linéaires. Egis est un groupe international de conseil, d’ingénierie de la construction et de services à la mobilité . Présent dans 120 pays , Egis s’appuie sur l’expertise de ses 20 500 collaborateurs pour accompagner ses clients et développer des solutions de pointe adaptées à tous les projets. Egis intervient dans la conception et la réalisation de grands projets d’infrastructures et d’aménagement sur le continent africain. En Afrique, les équipes d’Egis accompagnent les maîtres d’ouvrage en assistance technique et en maîtrise d’œuvre sur des projets ferroviaires structurants : LGV, lignes nouvelles classiques, modernisation de réseaux existants, adaptation d’installations terminales, aménagement de gares, mise au gabarit de quais et projets de fret ferroviaire, au Maroc comme dans d’autres pays du continent. En tant qu’Ingénieur chargé d’études en tracé ferroviaire et aménagement (F/H), vous collaborerez étroitement avec les chefs de projet et les projeteurs afin de concevoir les infrastructures et aménagements confiés, sur les volets techniques et graphiques. Par la diversité de ses missions, le Groupe contribue à structurer les territoires et à améliorer le cadre de vie des citoyens partout dans le monde. Description du poste Dans le cadre de notre développement et du renforcement de nos équipes, nous recrutons un Ingénieur confirmé chargé d'études tracé ferroviaire et aménagement . Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Vous contribuerez à la conception d’infrastructures de transport responsables, connectées et engagées en faveur d’une mobilité durable. Au sein de notre activité Transport , vous prendrez part à la conception et à la réalisation de projets ferroviaires ambitieux, innovants et durables, notamment : La réalisation d’études de tracé et d’aménagement à toutes les étapes du projet : faisabilité, avant-projet, projet, dossiers de consultation des entreprises, études d’exécution et visa des plans d’exécution. La contribution technique aux réponses aux appels d’offres. La conception de tracés ferroviaires sur lignes existantes ou nouvelles, incluant la production de pièces graphiques, les quantitatifs de terrassement et VRD, les notes descriptives et les estimations. Le pilotage, le suivi et le contrôle des marchés topographiques. Les études d’aménagement des gares et de mise aux normes des quais, en lien avec les études de gabarit ferroviaire. La participation aux réunions avec les clients, partenaires et autorités locales. Le suivi de la planification et de la gestion des affaires qui vous sont confiées. Le classement et l’archivage, au format papier et numérique, des dossiers et documents que vous réalisez ou pilotez. La participation aux initiatives d’innovation liées à la transition écologique, à l’écoconception, aux nouvelles méthodes de travail (BIM, réalité virtuelle) et au développement d’infrastructures bas carbone, intelligentes et non polluantes. Selon ses compétences et son expérience, le collaborateur pourra également être amené à : Assurer un contrôle de second niveau des études réalisées par d’autres collaborateurs de la cellule ; Réaliser des expertises techniques, des estimations ou des avis d’expert sur des études de tracé et des aménagements de complexité limitée ; Effectuer des contrôles extérieurs relevant de sa spécialité sur des affaires simples. Concrètement, l’ingénieur chargé d’études tracé ferroviaire intervient sur les missions suivantes : Garantir la conformité des études et missions aux référentiels et normes applicables, notamment par l’autocontrôle. Transformer les besoins fonctionnels en solutions géométriques et constructives conformes aux référentiels, en cohérence avec les objectifs de sécurité et de performance du réseau. Adapter ses compétences aux différents contextes ferroviaires, ligne nouvelle, ligne conventionnelle ou augmentation de capacité de lignes existantes et concevoir des tracés ferroviaires ainsi que des aménagements de quais techniquement robustes. Produire des plans et des pièces écrites directement exploitables par les projets et les métiers en interface. Mettre son expertise technique au service de l’équipe projet, dans son domaine de spécialité, en respectant les règles métier, les délais et le niveau de complexité propre à chaque mission. Alerter le chef de projet sur les enjeux de sécurité, de conformité ou nécessitant un arbitrage, et informer les experts de la cellule de tout risque de dérive des délais, des coûts ou de la charge d’études. Qualifications Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur Bac +5 en génie civil, travaux publics ou d’un master équivalent, et justifiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience réussie sur un poste similaire, en conception de projets ferroviaires complexes. Vous justifiez d’une solide expérience dans les projets de transport ferroviaire sur lignes conventionnelles ou nouvelles, ainsi que dans la modernisation de voies existantes avec travaux sous exploitation, nécessitant l’application de règles de conception et de mesures de sécurité spécifiques : Tracé de lignes ferroviaires classiques et, idéalement, de lignes nouvelles, notamment LGV. Bonne maîtrise de la géométrie de la voie, de ses normes et paramètres associés. Connaissance des notions de gabarit, des normes et des paramètres géométriques associés. Connaissances solides en génie civil. Connaissances en projets routiers et VRD. Connaissances générales en topographie. Maîtrise des interfaces entre terrassement, ouvrages d’art, drainage et assainissement. Vous disposez d’une connaissance approfondie de l’aménagement des gares et des installations terminales. Vous maîtrisez les normes, référentiels et bonnes pratiques applicables au Maroc et à l’international, notamment SNCF, AFNOR et STI. Vous maîtrisez les logiciels AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Mensura et/ou Covadis / Géorail ; la connaissance de BricsCAD ou Revit constitue un atout. Une expérience de l’environnement de conception BIM appliqué à un projet d’infrastructure constitue un atout. Vous maîtrisez les marchés publics, les CCAG travaux, fournitures et services, ainsi que les procédures réglementaires applicables au Maroc ; la connaissance de la loi MOP en France serait un plus. Vous possédez de bonnes compétences en estimation des coûts, planification et rédaction de pièces techniques. Vous êtes force de proposition dans la conception d’ouvrages durables et souhaitez contribuer à des projets complexes répondant aux enjeux actuels de l’écoconception. Qualités personnelles Rigueur, sens de l’organisation, autonomie et curiosité technique. Grande autonomie, associée à une bonne capacité de synthèse et de reporting. Disponibilité, implication et culture du résultat. Capacité d’encadrement et sens de l’écoute. Esprit d’équipe, sens de l’innovation et aptitude à travailler en mode projet. Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et bonne aisance orale en français, la maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un atout. Qualités relationnelles indispensables pour maintenir un dialogue constructif avec le client et les partenaires dans des contextes complexes.
